summary: Figure 7 gives 29 numerical day-39 hypothalamus log2 fold changes for low versus high ADG. Of these, 28 match registered genes and all 28 agree in direction (Pearson 0.9954, Spearman 0.9854). The comparison is restricted to the printed genes and falls below the 30-pair concordance minimum.

manualReview.summary: Original day-39 hypothalamus effects compared on the genes printed in Figure 7
manualReview.note: The accepted manuscript names GSE324226. Figure 7 prints 29 day-39 hypothalamic log2 fold changes for low relative to high average daily gain (ADG). All 28 genes with a registered coefficient agree in direction (Pearson 0.9954, Spearman 0.9854). Figure 4B gives a separate direction check on 41 of 50 labels, with 41 matching signs. The paper reports a DESeq2 Wald test with median-of-ratios normalization. The displayed formula includes ADG class and sex. The text also reports adjustment for RNA integrity number (RIN). The registered edgeR quasi-likelihood fit uses TMM normalization and ADG class alone. The 28 numerical pairs fall below the 30 required by author-concordance-v2. The publisher links five supplements. The supplementary PDF describes a Table S9 workbook that neither publisher inventory lists. Both GEO workbooks contain sample-level expression. In the normalized worksheet, X4333 contains a gene identifier in sample A035's expression column. The comparison uses the raw workbook for identifier tracing.
reviewFlags: The original paper supplies selected effects. The full gene-wise author statistics and the exact covariate specification remain unresolved.

verificationReview.reason: All 28 paired Figure 7 coefficients agree in direction (Pearson 0.9954, Spearman 0.9854). These represent 28 of 29 selected author genes and fall two pairs short of the concordance minimum. The reviewed sources do not supply exact per-gene DE P values, adjusted P values, or a full tested-gene table for this comparison. The author and registered models differ in normalization, estimator and adjustment.
verificationReview.nextStep: Obtain the authors' day-39 hypothalamus low-minus-high DESeq2 export with stable gene IDs, coefficients, raw P and adjusted P for every tested gene. Request the sample design with sex and RIN, the rule used to select the 80 DEGs, the cited Table S9 workbook and confirmation of the day-39 correlation sheet's tissue headers.

comparabilityReview.basis: Published Figure 7 day-39 hypothalamic log2 fold changes paired with the registered edgeR-QL DE table. Figure 4B supplies a separate descriptive direction check.
comparabilityReview.reference: Ferreres-Serafini et al., Scientific Reports, 10.1038/s41598-026-71457-7. Accepted article PDF page 12, all hypothalamic labels in Figure 7. Figure 4B is on PDF page 8.

cohort.note: The paper identifies GSE324226. All twelve GEO day-39 hypothalamus libraries match the registered sample sheet, including six high-ADG controls and six low-ADG cases. The animal was the sampling unit. Table S1 documents the individual final ADG classes and shared pens. GEO library IDs and the animal IDs in S1 use different identifiers. Pen and litter were not independently balanced.

contrast.note: Both compare whole hypothalamus at day 39 using final day-0-to-39 ADG classification. Figures 4B and 7 explicitly use High-ADG as the reference. No sign reversal. Day 7 and ileum are outside scope.

features.note: Preserved all 29 Figure 7 hypothalamic labels and required a one-to-one match. The Ensembl labels ending in 35675 and 27491 trace uniquely to the registered METTL7A and COA1 rows across the twelve deposited counts. Pig UniProt entries link RANBP2 to ENSSSCG00000008136, which traces to LOC100511376. CLDN9 occurs in the registered expression matrix and lacks a published DE coefficient. All joins and unmatched rows are retained.

effects.note: Both estimates are signed log2 fold changes for low relative to high ADG. The published values are printed to two decimal places. The authors used DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization and a Wald test. The displayed formula includes ADG class and sex, and the adjacent text also says RIN was included. The registered edgeR-QL fit uses TMM and ADG class alone. Median absolute difference 0.1289 log2 units, maximum 0.4932.

inference.note: Methods define a DEG by both nominal P < 0.05 and adjusted P < 0.20. Figure 4B labels its count of 80 as P < 0.01. Its point legend distinguishes nominal P < 0.05 and |log2FC| ≥ 1. All 50 transcribed labels have red or blue points indicating nominal P < 0.05. Of the 41 unambiguous pairs, 34 also meet that nominal threshold locally. Among 13,700 published DE rows, 428 meet nominal P < 0.05, zero meet the written joint rule and zero meet FDR < 0.05. The original full call set and exact DE P and adjusted P values could not be recovered from the reviewed sources. Paired P-value correlations and FDR overlap remain unassessed.

coverage.note: Figure 7 covers genes selected through DIABLO sparse partial least squares discriminant analysis. The plot shows day-39 cross-tissue Pearson correlations with |r| > 0.80. Of 29 printed hypothalamic effects, 28 pair (96.55% of the selected reference, 0.204% of 13,700 published DE rows). Local provenance records 15,110 tested rows, including 1,410 unpublished unmapped rows. Figure 4B gives directions for 50 labels. All 41 unambiguous pairs agree (82% of labels). Seven lack a published coefficient and two labels resolve to the same registered key. The figures share 11 labels.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use every printed Figure 7 hypothalamic coefficient, the authors' low-relative-to-high orientation and one-to-one identifier matches. For a selected reference, author-concordance-v2 requires 30 paired effects, at least 90% coverage of selected author genes and compatible cohort, contrast, identifiers and effect definitions. Both correlations must reach 0.90, or same-gene direction agreement must reach 90% across at least 30 nonzero pairs covering at least 90% of all pairs. The separate Figure 4B sign check cannot add numerical pairs.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: All 28 paired Figure 7 coefficients agree in direction (Pearson 0.9954, Spearman 0.9854). These represent 28 of 29 selected author genes and fall two pairs short of the concordance minimum. The reviewed sources do not supply exact per-gene DE P values, adjusted P values, or a full tested-gene table for this comparison.

additionalComparisonSpec.authorMethod: DESeq2 Wald, final ADG class with sex. RIN is reported separately in Methods. Figure 7 displays rounded coefficients.

openIssues: Figure 7 represents selected DIABLO genes with displayed cross-tissue links above |r| = 0.80. Only 28 printed coefficients can be paired. A full author tested-gene universe with exact gene-wise DE P and adjusted P values was not located in the reviewed sources.

The supplement describes Table S9. Neither publisher inventory lists its workbook. All Figure 7 hypothalamic labels occur in the day-39 biomarker spreadsheet block headed Ileum. Its correlations cannot substitute for DE coefficients or gene-level DE P values.

The displayed DESeq2 formula includes sex, and the adjacent text also names RIN. The manuscript and Figure 4B use different significance labels. The exact design and author call set require the authors' original export.
